package controller

import (
	"k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/runtime"
	"sigs.k8s.io/controller-runtime/pkg/client"
)

func integrationImplementation() integrationAdapter {
	return integrationAdapter{
		object:   object,
		register: func(*runtime.Scheme) error { return nil },
		reconciler: func(kube client.Client, scheme *runtime.Scheme) integrationController {
			return &Reconciler{Client: kube, Scheme: scheme}
		},
		hasBindingManifests: true,
	}
}
